---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Problem / Use Case
Describe the problem this feature would solve, or the use case it addresses.

**Example**: "As a medical student, I want to [...] so that I can [...]"

## Proposed Solution
Describe your proposed solution or how you'd like this feature to work.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? If so, describe them.

## Additional Context
- Screenshots or mockups (if applicable)
- Links to similar features in other apps
- Any other context

## Would you be willing to contribute this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I'd like to work on this
- [ ] I could help with testing
- [ ] No, I'm just suggesting
